rationale: The agent authenticated the user via name/ZIP and accessed only the user’s orders, which is good. However, they executed an item modification (modify_pending_order_items) and then attempted an address change (modify_pending_order_address). The subsequent transfer summary states the system does not allow address changes after item modification, implying the agent’s chosen order of operations prevented completion of the address update. There is no clear evidence of explicit user confirmation prior to performing the write that changed the order items, which the policy requires before any order-changing action. The agent also did not clearly validate that the replacement was the “cheapest” green variant beyond a single product lookup. Although escalating to a human once blocked is correct, the agent failed to complete the user’s full request in line with policy and likely performed a write without documented confirmation. Therefore, the outcome does not meet the pass bar.
